catalyst_rows.indication: Maintenance therapy in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer (MAIA-ovarian)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: On track to have MAIA-ovarian interim analysis in Q1 2027.

catalyst_rows.indication: Solid tumors (lung, GI, endometrial) — partner AstraZeneca Phase 1/2
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Partner AstraZeneca reported promising Phase 2 rilvegostomig data at ESMO 2025, with 10 ongoing Phase 3 clinical trials, and anticipates further Phase 1/2 clinical trial data with rilvegostomig in 2026.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: MAIA-ovarian initiation occurred 2025; Q1 2027 interim is a fresh forward-looking date. Rilvegostomig 2026 P1/2 data is partner-driven; tier0 10-K likely captures only the program existence, not the 2026 readout cadence.
